method.cache: Warm OS cache after inventory and warmups; repeat calls, no reusable caller-created glob objects. Not cold-start or cold-disk.
method.order: Rotate engines every sample and rotate initial engine every case.
method.validation: Independent manifest oracle; every warmup and sample checked for exact set and duplicates. Sorting/normalizing for validation excluded.
method.timing: Includes public entry, matcher/crawler construction and full materialization. Sync calls timed synchronously; Promise results fully awaited.
method.memory: RSS immediately after minus before operation; GC before each operation, not timed. Not peak memory. All libraries loaded in one process.
method.cpu: process.cpuUsage user+system delta, includes native workers.
method.contracts: Unsorted relative paths, files AND directories; glob hides dot entries and ignores no gitignore rules; readdir includes dot entries. Fixtures reject symlinks/special files. Output slash/trailing directory slash normalized only for validation.
method.concurrency: Library defaults; Vooya glob 4, recursive readdir default Rayon pool. No threadpool environment override unless recorded.
